items.q: Why is it important to use an oral care system during the teething stage?
items.a: The teething stage is crucial for your child’s oral development, as it’s when their first teeth begin to emerge and the oral microbiome—the community of beneficial bacteria in the mouth—starts to establish itself. Using a system designed specifically for this stage ensures that your child’s teeth and gums are protected while the natural balance of the microbiome is nurtured. Our products are formulated with the safest, most effective ingredients, all ranked #1 by the Environmental Working Group (EWG), making them incredibly safe for your child.

items.q: Why should I choose a system versus buying individual products?
items.a: Our systems are expertly curated by leading dentists and medical experts to ensure that every product works together to provide a comprehensive solution for your child’s oral care needs. Purchasing a system not only guarantees that all the necessary products are included but also offers the best price and additional value, such as educational content to support your child’s oral health journey. Additionally, our systems are designed to work perfectly on a subscription basis, so you’ll never run out of essential products, ensuring consistent care for your child.

items.q: How long does a System last?
items.a: Each System is designed to last 90 days — 3 full months — for the average user. Subscriptions deliver a fresh box every 90 days, with monthly or quarterly payment options, and you can adjust your delivery schedule anytime if your family uses more or less.

items.q: What accessories can I purchase to complement my teething system?
items.a: To enhance your teething system, consider adding children’s UV sanitizers, various character-based toothpaste dispensers, and music players featuring custom 2-minute songs. These accessories make oral care enjoyable and help establish positive associations with brushing from the start.

items.q: How can I ensure that my child enjoys their oral care routine at this early stage?
items.a: We make oral care fun and engaging with our ice cream-flavored toothpastes and products featuring our superheroes and supervillains. Your child can enjoy brushing while exploring their favorite characters through movies, music, and augmented reality. Visit our play page to learn more about these amazing characters and discover the magic of SuperMouth.
